sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Retailing of Fast-Fashion Apparel and Footwear

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (single national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force)
New Zealand–Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 30 of 2017 (as amended); International Companies Act 2007 (as amended); International Companies Regulations 2008; Companies Act [Cap. 191] as amended by beneficial ownership legislation; Financial Intelligence Unit Act [Cap. 286]; VFSC AML/CFT Regulatory Guidelines and UBO Register directives; APG Mutual Evaluation Follow-up framework.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not yet a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; verify status at the date of notarization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (constitutional documents)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (signed by a Vanuatu notary public, then legalized by the destination consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Status)
Certified extract of the Beneficial Ownership Register
Notarized identification, proof of address, and source-of-wealth documents of proposed UBOs and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the home jurisdiction plus Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (origin-country notarization followed by Vanuatu consular legalization)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every director, shareholder, UBO, and authorized signatory against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU and UK OFSI consolidated lists, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions implementing UNSC resolutions under the AML/CFT Act No. 30 of 2017. PEPs, family members, and close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence including source-of-wealth validation, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening is executed by the licensed registered agent at incorporation and on a continuous basis thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry online name-reservation portal (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Legal names must be in Latin alphabetic characters (English, French, or Bislama). Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Mandarin characters) are not permitted in the registered name but may be used as an unofficial trade name abroad. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or an approved abbreviation ('Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc', 'SA'). Bislama names are permissible if not misleading or contrary to public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant files a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching name-search evidence, an explanation of distinctive elements, and any consent from the objecting party. The Registrar issues a written determination within 21 days. An adverse determination may be challenged by judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act 2016. A reserved name may be extended for one additional 30-day period upon payment of the prescribed renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the statutory registered office: the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the address of its licensed registered agent, where statutory registers and corporate records are kept. Back-office operations, fulfillment, and management may be conducted remotely outside Vanuatu; the e-commerce fast-fashion business is not required to maintain employees or premises in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the entity itself (approximately 5% annual probability). However, the licensed registered agent is subject to unannounced VFSC inspections at any time and may be required to produce KYC and UBO records without prior notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (Cap. 222) of Vanuatu, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008, 2010 and 2011; in particular ss. 4-9 (incorporation, memorandum and articles), s. 10 (registered agent), s. 11 (registered office), ss. 13-17 (shares and capital), ss. 23-25 (directors and officers), and s. 111 (tax exemption).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies and Trusts Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Reservation and Registration of an International Company (Form RIC-1) and Certificate of Incorporation of an International Company, prescribed under the International Companies Act regulations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an International Company. The company may be incorporated without issued capital or with one or more shares of any par value; standard VFSC practice accepts US$1 issued share capital. No escrow account or deposit is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED at the first meeting of the board of directors of the Company as follows: (1) The Company subscribes for and accepts the allotment of one hundred ordinary shares of VUV 1,000 each to the founding shareholder, consideration being fully satisfied as recorded in the Register of Members. (2) The registered office shall be maintained at the licensed office of the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the registered agent is authorized to file all returns with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. (3) [Director Name] is appointed director and [Officer Name] corporate secretary, empowered to execute banking mandates, e-commerce merchant agreements, and statutory filings. Adopted and effective this day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search and Reservation with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies and Trusts Registry, Port Vila, acting through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed English company names to a VFSC-licensed registered agent, who lodges a formal name reservation request with the Registry. Each name must be unique, not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity, and must not imply a government connection, banking, insurance, or other regulated activity. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 14 days pending formal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form (signed by the proposed incorporator)
Two alternative proposed company names in descending preference
Certified copy of the passport and proof of residential address of the founding beneficial owner
Brief business description confirming electronic retailing of fast-fashion apparel and footwear (ISIC 4791)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused on grounds of similarity, prohibited connotation, or registrability, the registered agent resubmits an amended name preference list within two business days; the VFSC priority review is retained without payment of a new government filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association and Engagement of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (authorized under s. 10 of the International Companies Act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association, fixes the registered office address at the agent's licensed premises in Port Vila, and arranges execution of incorporation documents by the subscriber. The constitutional documents may include flexible share class powers, director indemnity provisions, and English governing-law clauses. KYC, source-of-funds declarations, and registered agent engagement letters are executed concurrently.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in English
Subscriber consent and declaration appointing the first director
Certified KYC dossier of the director and beneficial owner (passport, bank reference, utility bill)
Name reservation certificate issued by the VFSC
Registered agent engagement letter and registered office consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Memorandum and Articles are rejected for legal insufficiency, corrective amendments are filed through the registered agent; where the defect is purely formal or typographical, the VFSC accepts a curative filing without reopening the full review period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of Incorporation Application with the VFSC and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies and Trusts Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the completed Form RIC-1, executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, director's consent, registered agent's consent, and declaration of compliance, together with the VFSC government fee of US$250. An expedited 24-hour service is available where all dossiers are complete and no enhanced due diligence is triggered by the low-risk e-commerce business profile.
required_dossiers: Completed Form RIC-1 application for registration of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber
Consent to act as the first director (signed)
Consent of the licensed registered agent
Proof of electronic transfer of government fees and first-year VFSC license levy
Beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition, the registered agent responds within the statutory 14-day cure period; for defects in the declaration of compliance, the subscriber executes a confirmatory declaration and the certificate of incorporation is back-dated to the original lodgement date where permitted by VFSC practice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Constitution of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the registered agent (post-registration statutory compliance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon VFSC approval, the Certificate of Incorporation is issued and the company acquires legal personality. The board then adopts the pre-executed Memorandum and Articles, opens the statutory registers (members, directors, charges, and beneficial ownership), issues share certificates against consideration recorded in the Register of Members, and confirms the appointment of the corporate secretary and any additional officers.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the VFSC
Seal (adopted optionally by board resolution)
Share certificates issued to the founding shareholder
Statutory registers of members, directors, charges, and beneficial owners
Consents to act executed by all directors and the corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical error in the name, date, or company number, the registered agent files an administrative rectification application; the VFSC issues a corrective certificate within five business days without requiring re-lodgement of the constitutional documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Commercial Activation (Banking, Payment Rails, and Beneficial Ownership Filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directors and corporate secretary; VFSC for beneficial ownership filings; authorized commercial banks and payment service providers for settlement infrastructure
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass the first written resolution adopting the pro forma governance actions, then open a corporate bank account and enrol with Klarna (BNPL) and Shopify Payments as settlement rails, submitting certified corporate documents and beneficial ownership declarations to satisfy AML/KYC underwriting. File final beneficial ownership particulars with the VFSC and confirm that, as an offshore International Company conducting e-commerce only outside Vanuatu, no domestic business licence is required.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or unanimous written consent (signed by the director)
Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and certificate of good standing (if requested)
Passport and KYC dossiers of directors, secretary, and ultimate beneficial owner
Bank account opening forms and FATCA/CRS self-certifications
Payment provider underwriting pack for the e-commerce merchant (ISIC 4791)
VFSC beneficial ownership registration filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or payment provider requires enhanced due diligence, the directors supply notarized and apostilled corporate documents and a VFSC certificate of good standing; where a requested institution declines the file, alternative licensed banking partners or an alternative BNPL aggregator will be engaged without re-opening the VFSC incorporation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a pure offshore International Company carrying on cross-border e-commerce. If the company establishes physical premises in Vanuatu, the Port Vila Municipal Council or the relevant Provincial Council under the Business Licence Act (Cap. 170) and the Department of Industry of the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry, Co-operatives and Commerce would become competent for a local operating licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable; no operating or manufacturing permit is required for offshore electronic retailing of fast-fashion apparel. A discretionary Business Licence under the Business Licence Act (Cap. 170) is mandatory only if the International Company operates a bricks-and-mortar or warehouse presence in Vanuatu, which would undermine its tax-exempt offshore classification.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category C) for pure electronic retailing with no physical footprint; a Registration-level screening (Form 1) is triggered only where a distribution warehouse exceeds 500 m2 or generates substantial packaging waste within a sensitive area. No Full EIA Report is anticipated for apparel and footwear storage, picking, and dispatch operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply to pure e-commerce operations; any warehousing must comply with the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations and the Waste Management Act, including segregation of textile and plastic packaging, contracted municipal waste collection, and a prohibition on open burning of waste. Any facility-generated wastewater must meet DEPC trade-waste discharge limits and municipal sewer acceptance criteria.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to an offshore e-commerce entity without local premises. If a leased fulfilment centre or office is established, the occupier must obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VFES), a structural load-inspection approval from the Public Works Department, and an occupational health and safety clearance under the Employment Act before occupancy, with a fire-warden plan and first-aid provision as standard conditions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury (Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company registration; no dedicated income tax authority)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing a Vanuatu International Company (IC) must register with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent. No tax identification number (TIN) is issued because Vanuatu imposes no income tax, VAT, or withholding tax. For customs purposes, the Vanuatu Customs Service assigns a customs code upon import/export registration. Since the entity is non-resident and conducts offshore business, no domestic tax ID procurement is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election mechanisms. The International Companies Act 1992 guarantees exemption from all taxes on offshore business income, and no entity-level tax election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / GST / Sales and Use Tax (only customs duties on imports)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT or GST system in force
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not mandate electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance. Invoices are issued commercially without government clearance or digital stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Vanuatu does not levy export VAT. Exports of goods and services are outside the scope of any indirect tax. No zero-rating regime exists because there is no VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (where applicable for physical goods leaving Vanuatu)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT export zero-rating fraud penalties apply as no VAT exists. However, misrepresentation in customs declarations is subject to Vanuatu Customs Act penalties including fines up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment, and loss of the International Company tax exemption if the entity engages in prohibited domestic trading activities under the International Companies Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - Financial Services Group, Exchange Control Division; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers International Company incorporation and licensing-adjacent integrity obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu is an IMF Article VIII member. The Vatu (VUV) enjoys unrestricted convertibility for both current and capital account transactions, including profit remittances, interest, royalties, and capital repatriation. Vanuatu International Companies (VU_IC) are tax-exempt and face no statutory withholding on shareholder distributions; practical constraints on fast-fashion e-commerce remittances arise only from payment processor settlement cycles and bank-maintained trade transparency controls, not from RBV convertibility restrictions. Non-resident shareholders may freely convert VUV into foreign currency through an authorized dealer, with only statistical filing thresholds rather than prior RBV approval for non-bank transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 61) and applicable RBV general consents, resident exporters must offer 100% of foreign-currency export proceeds to an authorized dealer within 180 days of exportation. A VU_IC registered under the International Companies Act is classified as non-resident and offshore for exchange-control purposes where goods are purchased and sold outside Vanuatu; accordingly, the mandatory surrender obligation is largely disapplied for e-commerce apparel turnover. Where proceeds are repatriated to Vanuatu, the VU_IC must report to the RBV on a statistical basis through the receiving authorized dealer if conversion into VUV is sought; foreign-currency retention in a designated offshore account is permitted without surrender, provided monthly exchange-control statistics are filed.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Vanuatu has no local EMI licensing class for foreign digital banks; offshore EMIs are not legally authorized to hold VUV or to clear Vanuatu-denominated e-commerce proceeds. Shopify Payments and Klarna BNPL must settle funds through a founding licensed bank or an international payment service provider operating as a money transmitter; a VU_IC may maintain a non-resident USD account with a global EMI only if that EMI holds an RBV-recognized money transfer licence or uses a VUV-licensed bank as clearing sponsor. Recommended architecture: master treasury account at ANZ/BNP with processor-level disbursement sub-accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A natural-person director or designated senior officer of the VU_IC must attend, at minimum, one live in-person interview at the Port Vila branch of the chosen lender. Remote opening is generally reserved for existing banking clients; with non-resident UBOs, the interview may be conducted by the Vanuatu Registered Agent under a written power-of-attorney evidenced by certified true copies of passports for all directors and UBOs. The mandate is commensurate with enhanced due diligence and the bank's internal offshore-company policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore company opacity and historical risk of bearer shares in International Company registries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Registration Certificate and authenticated Register of Directors/Members under the International Companies Act; (2) notarized ownership chart identifying all natural-person UBOs; (3) certified passports plus utility bills of the UBO and any nominee chain; (4) Registered Agent's character certificate from VFSC; (5) negative-news and adverse-media screening reports on all directors and UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of wealth from aggregated BNPL and marketplace payment settlement flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) executed merchant agreements with Shopify Payments and Klarna; (2) four consecutive monthly platform settlement statements; (3) platform-level sales and chargeback reports; (4) interbank trace of processor funding wires; (5) annual audited or management-account profit-and-loss statement mapping consumer receipts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Supply-chain transaction structure spanning high-risk garment-export jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) per-recipient supplier KYB forms with trade-name registrations; (2) commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading; (3) executed master purchase agreements; (4) customs-entry summary evidence from the destination country; (5) vendor bank details placed on SWIFT beneficiary-risk control lists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, and negative-news flags triggered by cross-border e-commerce brand or territory exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) independent sanctions/OFAC/EU/UN screening certification; (2) geo-blocking attestation excluding prohibited jurisdictions; (3) UBO beneficial-owner statement under sworn affidavit; (4) compliance declaration that 100% of revenue is derived from arm's-length retail sales; (5) legal opinion from Vanuatu counsel confirming the IC's offshore status and absence of tax-avoidance purpose.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections are instructed via SWIFT MT103 with the purpose narrative 'Capital Contribution - VU_IC' and credited to a block-designated USD capital account at an RBV authorized dealer. No prior RBV licence is required because Vanuatu imposes no capital-import approval for non-resident International Companies. The receiving bank requests standard source-of-funds forms and a UBO declaration; the treasury strategy is to retain a USD-denominated master account at ANZ or BNP, avoiding unnecessary conversion into VUV, while funds requiring VUV disbursement are converted only at the point of payment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Procurement payments to garment suppliers and fast-fashion logistics providers clear through (a) irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued by the Port Vila authorized dealer under UCP600 and transmitted by SWIFT MT700/MT707 for consignment values above USD 25,000; (b) commercial SWIFT MT103 or MT103+ cover payments for prepayment and open-account amounts, attaching the invoice and packing list through SWIFT gpi; (c) priority USD clearing via the bank's US correspondent to achieve same-day value. Recommended terms: 30%-60% T/T advance before shipment, balance against scanned bill of lading; first-time suppliers in Vietnam or Bangladesh use at-sight documentary credits.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign-exchange contracts with RBV-licensed authorized dealers, maximum tenor of 12 months, hedging committed USD revenue into VUV or AUD for local operating-cost exposure

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV executed with G7-domiciled banking counterparties under ISDA/CEMA master agreements, documented as treasury hedges and not settled through the local clearing system
Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps (USD/VUV) transacted with the settlement bank to bridge payment-timing mismatches on BNPL and Shopify receivables
Purchased FX options and zero-cost collars with OECD-domiciled counterparties limited to prudential hedging of committed USD/VUV liabilities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary of the company's registration, within one calendar month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately USD 10 per month; continued default may result in administrative strike-off after formal notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee (where separate from return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of registration; generally bundled with annual return filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment triggers suspension of certificate of incorporation and strike-off proceedings by VFSC

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a standard International Company; audit is required only if the company's articles so provide, if applicable tax-law requires it, or if VFSC directs examination in exceptional circumstances
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu International Companies Act requires retention of sufficient accounting records; no mandated GAAP, with IFRS being the commonly applied standard for voluntarily prepared financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO return is filed with the Registry; the company and its registered agent must maintain and update a beneficial ownership register upon any shareholding transfer or allotment, subject to penalties for non-update

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu is a zero-corporate-income-tax jurisdiction; no tax is levied on profits, capital gains, or remittances.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% effective exemption for International Companies under the Companies (International) Act 2021 (successor to the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]): each IC receives a 20-year statutory exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, levies, and VAT on offshore activities, renewable for successive periods; no national payroll tax, capital gains tax, or municipal profit tax applies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: 0 (inapplicable - no CIT base exists; loss-carryforward rules are not enacted)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return and Annual Licence Fee Renewal - filed through the VFSC Online portal (online.vfsc.vu) under the Companies (International) Act 2021.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual fee is payable on the anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and unique VFSC registration number (e.g., IC-12345) as recorded at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must instruct a licenced Vanuatu registered agent to verify the name and submit the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered-office address in Vanuatu and name of the appointed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the agent's office serves as the service-of-process address for non-resident principals.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport/ID details of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: UBO data is confidential but mandatory; any change of director or UBO must be lodged with VFSC within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation whether the IC carried on a relevant activity (e.g., distribution and service centre) in Vanuatu during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A 'yes' answer triggers the separate ESR annual filing and the VUV 200,000 ESR annual fee; a 'no' answer must be consistent with no local employees or premises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a VUF 10,000 late penalty; non-payment of the annual fee for three months after the anniversary results in automatic strike-off by VFSC; directors are personally liable for debts contracted while the company is in default.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return - filed through the VFSC Economic Substance Online Portal under the Economic Substance Regulations Act 2022 (Act No. 30 of 2022).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annually by 31 December per VFSC practice notices; the first filing covered the short period 1 July - 31 December 2023 and was due 31 December 2023.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC legal name, VFSC registration number, financial year-end, and registered-agent reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the identical legal name as in the annual return; mismatches cause portal rejection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select Banking, Insurance, Shipping, Fund Management, Financing and Leasing, Headquarters, Holding Company, IP, or Distribution and Service Centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fast-fashion e-commerce retail maps to Distribution and Service Centre; if the IC merely owns trademarks licensed to group sellers, classify as IP Activity, which attracts the highest substance scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees, physical premises details, annual operating expenditure, and description of core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A desk in a registered agent's office with no staff and no local payroll will fail the adequacy review; appoint an in-country compliance manager and maintain local payroll records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from the relevant activity and revenue derived from Vanuatu sources, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide turnover for the substance benchmark; this return is not a tax computation and creates no Vanuatu CIT liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorised agent, date, and attestation of accuracy under penalty of ESR offences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors cannot delegate the attestation; an agent signing on behalf of a director requires a written board resolution filed with VFSC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: First-year non-compliance: VUV 10,000,000 penalty; continued non-compliance: VUV 50,000,000 per year; false declaration: criminal fine up to VUV 50,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 10 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (VIRIS) - electronic filing via the Vanuatu Integrated Revenue Information System under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 285].
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last working day of the month following the end of the taxable period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Supplier Details and VAT Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and 8-digit VAT registration number (VU-XXXX-XX).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Relevant only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu; offshore consumer sales are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total value of taxable supplies and VAT collected at the standard rate of 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exported goods are zero-rated; no VAT is chargeable on offshore e-commerce fulfilment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT incurred on local purchases attributable to Vanuatu taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not claim input VAT on offshore procurement or exempt activities; retain valid VAT invoices for at least five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: VUV 25,000 fixed penalty; late payment: 2% monthly surcharge on unpaid VAT; intentional evasion: criminal fine and imprisonment on conviction of responsible officers.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax and no tax on profits distributed by an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu currently maintains no comprehensive double-tax treaty network in force, so no local WHT reduction is required. Where a foreign jurisdiction demands evidence of tax status, the IC may apply through its registered agent to the VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Residence / Exemption Certificate, which attests the 20-year statutory tax exemption and the company's good standing; issuance generally takes 5-10 business days upon payment of the application fee.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rate: 0% for royalties and debt-interest paid to or by an International Company. Treaty rates: not applicable in the absence of comprehensive DTAAs; existing TIEAs (e.g., with Australia and New Zealand) govern information exchange only and do not alter rates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - no transfer pricing documentation regime (Local File or Master File) has been enacted in Vanuatu, consistent with the zero-CIT environment. The operative compliance threshold is the ESR regime: every International Company carrying on a relevant activity, including e-commerce distribution and service centres, must file the annual Economic Substance Return irrespective of revenue; there is no local-currency de minimis threshold (VUV or USD).
